sources.title: llmware/tiny-llama-chat-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: tiny-llama-chat-onnx is an ONNX int4 quantized version of TinyLlama-Chat, providing a very fast, very small inference implementation, optimized for AI PCs using Intel GPU, CPU and NPU. tiny-llama-chat is the official chat finetuned version of tiny-llama. sources.title: TinyLlama: An Open-Source Small Language Model - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present TinyLlama, a compact 1.1B language model pretrained on around 1 trillion tokens for up to 3 epochs 1. Building on the architecture and tokenizer of Llama 2 (Touvron et al., 2023b, ), TinyLlama leverages various advances contributed by the open-source community, e.g., FlashAttention (Dao,, 2023) and Lit-GPT (Lightning-AI,, 2023), achieving better computational efficiency ...
